old_target: S100A8 -> RAGE-dependent modulation of PDGF-induced airway-smooth-muscle migration; intracellular relay not resolved
new_target: S100A8 -> RAGE-dependent modulation of PDGF-induced airway-smooth-muscle migration; intracellular relay not resolved
decision_basis: Primary rat airway-smooth-muscle study reports that exogenous S100A8 inhibits PDGF-induced migration and that a RAGE-neutralizing antibody blocks the effect. This supports a bounded S100A8-RAGE functional edge, but not purified binding or a terminal TF target.

old_target: TGFbeta -> alphavbeta5/zyxin adhesome -> vinculin organization and ventral stress fibers
new_target: TGFbeta -> alphavbeta5/zyxin adhesome -> vinculin organization and ventral stress fibers
decision_basis: Primary mouse and human epithelial-cell study shows that TGF-beta induces ventral stress fibers, integrin-beta5 suppression reduces the response, and integrin-beta5 constructs restore defined cytoskeletal/focal-adhesion features. This supports a bounded TGF-beta-integrin-beta5 functional edge, not direct ligand-receptor binding or a terminal TF target.
